function.name: criminal_case_details_get
function.description: Retrieve the details of a specific criminal case. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

case_number.description: The official number of the case in the judiciary system.

court_id.description: The ID of the court where the case was held.

include_hearing_details.description: Flag indicating if hearing details should also be retrieved. Default: False
